headline: Barclays Maintains Overweight on Intl Flavors & Fragrances, Raises Price Target to $105
summary: Barclays  analyst Lauren Lieberman   maintains Intl Flavors & Fragrances (NYSE:IFF) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $96 to $105.

headline: What to Expect From International Flavors & Fragrances' Q3 2026 Earnings Report
summary: International Flavors & Fragrances is set to release its third-quarter earnings next month, and analysts expect a double-digit decrease in its EPS.
